faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.seoDescription: How Sokan works for shippers and freight forwarders: pricing, privacy, quotes and bookings.

items.q: Is Sokan really free for shippers?
items.a: Yes. Posting requests, receiving quotes and booking are free for shippers. Forwarders pay a small fee to access requests, which is how Sokan is funded.
Verified forwarders who handle your transport mode and lane see the route and cargo summary. Your name, company and contact details are only revealed to forwarders who unlock the request.

items.q: How quickly will I get quotes?
items.a: Requests are sent to matching forwarders the moment you publish. Most shippers receive their first quotes within a few hours.

items.q: Am I obliged to accept a quote?
items.a: No. You can compare quotes, ask questions and decide not to book. Unused requests simply expire.
Quotes are itemised and include a validity date. Final pricing can depend on exact cargo details and carrier rates — always confirm inclusions with the forwarder before shipping.
Anything legal: general cargo, dangerous goods, temperature-controlled, oversized and project cargo, vehicles and more, by sea, air, road, rail or courier.
Sokan is prepaid. You top up a wallet and pay a small fee when you unlock a request's full details, and another when you submit a quote. Every plan includes free unlocks and quotes each month.
Full shipment details — exact addresses, packing list, notes and attachments — plus the customer's name and contact details.

items.q: Can I choose which requests I receive?
items.a: Yes. You receive requests only for the transport modes you offer and, optionally, only for the countries you cover.
Complete your company profile and licence details. Our team reviews every forwarder before activation and awards the verified badge after checking your documents.
Any time from your wallet. Upgrades take effect immediately; the monthly fee is charged from your wallet.

how.seoDescription: Post a freight request, get competing quotes from verified forwarders, compare and book — step by step.
how.title: Freight buying, without the back-and-forth
how.subtitle: One request replaces dozens of emails and phone calls. Here's exactly what happens.

d1.title: You describe the shipment
d1.text: Choose the transport mode, route and dates, then add cargo details — containers, pallets or just total weight. Sokan calculates chargeable weight for you.

d2.title: We route it to the right forwarders
d2.text: Your request goes to every active, verified forwarder that handles your mode and covers your lane. They see the route and cargo — not who you are.

d3.title: Forwarders unlock and quote
d3.text: Interested forwarders unlock your full details and send an itemised quote with transit time, validity and inclusions. You're notified as each one arrives.

d4.title: You compare and book
d4.text: Quotes are ranked by price with the fastest option highlighted. Accept one and you both get each other's direct contact to finalise the booking.

d5.title: Rate the experience
d5.text: After booking, leave a review. Ratings help other shippers choose — and reward the forwarders who deliver.

about.title: We put shippers at the helm
about.subtitle: Sokan — Persian for “helm” — gives businesses control over how their freight is bought.
about.story1: Getting a freight price still means emailing a list of forwarders, waiting days for replies and comparing quotes that never line up. Small shippers get ignored; good forwarders struggle to reach new customers.
about.story2: Sokan fixes both sides: shippers post once and receive comparable, itemised quotes; forwarders receive qualified demand on their lanes and pay only for leads they choose.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Sokan, a marketplace connecting shippers with independent freight forwarders.

s1.title: The service
s1.text: Sokan provides a platform for shippers to publish freight requests and for forwarders to submit quotes. Sokan is not a carrier or freight forwarder and is not a party to any transport contract concluded between users.

s2.title: Accounts
s2.text: You are responsible for the accuracy of information you provide and for keeping your credentials secure. Forwarders must hold all licences required to offer their services.

s3.title: Fees
s3.text: Sokan is free for shippers. Forwarders pay the fees of their selected plan from a prepaid wallet. Fees for unlocked requests and submitted quotes are non-refundable except where stated.

s4.title: Conduct
s4.text: Users must not post false requests, misleading quotes or use contact details obtained on Sokan for unsolicited marketing.

s5.title: Liability
s5.text: Transport services are provided by forwarders under their own terms. Sokan is not liable for the performance of any shipment or for losses arising from it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Sokan collects, why, and how we protect it.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.text: Account details (name, email, phone, company), shipment requests and quotes, and technical data needed to run the service.

s2.title: How requests are shared
s2.text: Matching forwarders see your route and cargo summary. Your identity and contact details are shared only with forwarders who unlock your request, and with the forwarder you book.

s3.title: Why we use data
s3.text: To deliver requests and quotes, notify you of activity, prevent abuse and improve Sokan. We never sell personal data.

s4.title: Retention
s4.text: We keep data while your account is active and as required by law. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.

s5.title: Your rights
s5.text: You may access, correct or delete your personal data. Contact us through the contact page for any privacy request.
